title: Placable
summary: PLA'CABLE, a. [L. placabilis, from placo, to pacify; probably formed on the root of lay. See Please.] That may be appeased or pacified; appeasable; admitting its passions or irritations to be allayed;

inlines.v: PLA'CABLE, a. [L. placabilis, from placo, to pacify; probably formed on the root of lay. See Please.] That may be appeased or pacified; appeasable; admitting its passions or irritations to be allayed; willing to forgive. Methought I saw him placable and mild.
